verdicts.reason: A copies the original block at its old scale into the square, so the headline and CTA cover a thin middle band with large dead areas above and below. The type is undersized for the format and the cluster looks pasted in, not re-laid out. B scales the headline and CTA up to fill the square better and gives them more room. It still leaves wide empty bands at the top and bottom. The tilted LIMITED badge still hangs off the left of the CTA, so the badge-plus-button pair isn't centred under the headline axis. The gap between the headline and the CTA is also a bit loose.
